# Release notes overrides: the text used in the release notes for a commit whose message can't be
# changed anymore (it's already on dev or main), for example one written before the New:, Changed:,
# Fixed:, Updated: and Removed: prefixes. One commit per line: the short or full SHA, a space, then
# the text, with its prefix, or "-" to leave the commit out. Commits given the same text are listed
# once. Lines starting with # are ignored. A line can stay after its release; it only matches that
